organizeAndLaunchWindowsAppsOnMac: Organize and launch your Windows applications on Mac
wineMacCenterDescription: Wine Mac Center is a modern graphical interface that allows you to manage Windows applications using Wine, simply and without complications.
downloadCommunityOpenScripts: Download community-open scripts to install applications.
easilyManageWineEngines: Easily manage Wine Engines, run Winetricks commands, download necessary files, and perform complete installation processes automatically, reproducibly, and much more comfortably. Ideal for simplifying complex configurations and sharing ready-to-use environments.
easilyOnEachOfYourApps: easily on each of your apps.
customizeSpecificParameters: Customize specific parameters, adjust Windows versions, manage libraries, environment variables, and advanced options without complications, keeping each app optimized and isolated according to its needs.
contributeDescription: Wine Mac Center is an open source project. Join us, contribute your code, report bugs, or suggest new ideas.
madeWithReactTypescriptAndElectron: Made with React, Typescript, and Electron
